MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.

4. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
6. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
